name: City of Toronto Development Pipeline 2025
update_frequency: Annual bulletin with quarterly dashboard updates
known_limitations: The pipeline combines planning and building-permit data for larger projects and describes potential supply at several stages. Proposed and approved units are not guaranteed completions, the dataset excludes as-of-right development below the site-plan threshold, and citywide aggregates do not establish the status or viability of application 24 254930.
automation_notes: Track quarterly dataset refreshes, stage transitions, citywide starts and completions, and project-specific permit records. Keep pipeline potential separate from delivered housing.
notes: Phase 51B delivery-capacity record. The 2025 bulletin was received by Planning and Housing Committee on June 11, 2026 and covers development activity through Q4 2025.
